neighbours.label: words meaning that something endures: lasting, long-lasting, permanent, eternal, forever; temporary, brief or merely durable things stay quiet
fire: The teachers hoped the trip would leave a lasting impression on the students.
The flood did permanent harm to the old library's foundations.
The battery is praised for its long-lasting charge.
The monks chanted prayers for eternal rest.
The tattoo was a permanent reminder of that summer.
Nothing in this world stays the same forever, she sighed.
Their rivalry grew into a lasting friendship.
The couple wanted a permanent address after years of travel.
quiet: The teachers hoped the trip would leave a good impression on the students.
The flood did serious harm to the old library's foundations.
The battery is praised for its quick charge.
The monks chanted prayers for a safe harvest.
The tattoo was a temporary sticker from the fair.
Nothing in this world stays the same for a week, she sighed.
Their rivalry grew into a brief friendship.
The couple wanted a cheaper address after years of rent increases.

notes: Probes: lasting 0.71, long-lasting 0.66, permanent 0.50, eternal 0.34, forever 0.23; temporary 0.14, durable 0.15, brief 0.04. The - pole fires just before such a word (a | permanent crown), with the output direction suppressing ' permanent' / ' lasting' on this pole.
